## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open Kineta at `...`
2. Scroll to `...` or click on `...`

Describe what should happen (e.g., smooth 60fps scroll pinning, drawer focus trap, variable font hover response).

## Actual Behavior

Describe what actually happened, including any console errors or layout shifts.

If applicable, attach screenshots or a short video demonstrating the visual or motion issue.
